policy: Use the least sufficient task-relative child profile. Ordinary judgment stays at P4; P5 requires deep unresolved reasoning or compound decision difficulty. Risks determine verification, not model rank; selection does not establish outcome quality.

E.purpose: efficient directed work with closed semantics

B.purpose: balanced complex coding, computer use, and professional judgment

profiles.purpose: exact lookup, fixed command, log filtering, or formatting
narrow research, structured summary, or deterministic mechanical change
confirmed bounded implementation or repetitive change with a deterministic oracle
large but clear context or a coordinated task with closed semantics
everyday coding, moderate ambiguity, ordinary diagnosis, or routine review
deep unresolved causes, conflicting oracles, or interacting open contract/high-consequence decisions
deep unresolved reasoning with interacting unknowns and cross-boundary impact
explicitly acknowledged and evaluated exceptional work only

workloads.purpose: exact file, symbol, or call-site location
official documentation, version note, or API research
directed repository-wide impact or call-chain mapping
ordinary causal diagnosis; conflicting evidence can raise the route
execute an exact command and preserve its first result
observe and adapt native UI or runtime checks against a confirmed outcome; exact commands remain exact-verification
classify bounded logs, failures, or environment evidence
fully specified mechanical change with a deterministic oracle
confirmed bounded bug fix or feature slice with a deterministic oracle
multi-step work with a clear outcome and closed semantics
cross-component implementation or ordinary contract judgment; interacting unresolved decisions require depth signals
routine independent integration or adversarial review
security, data, compatibility, or rollback review with full risk controls; unresolved complex reasoning requires depth signals
requirement semantics, dependency choice, architecture adjudication, or final claim

upgrade_rules.reason: larger working context with a clear brief can stay on Luna xhigh
semantic or causal judgment needs GPT-6.1 Sol medium
concrete deep unresolved reasoning or a documented current-Sol reasoning failure needs GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh
conflicting evidence that actually disputes the outcome oracle needs deeper discrimination
open meanings with interacting unknowns across a contract boundary need deeper reasoning
interacting unresolved meanings at a high-consequence acceptance boundary need deeper reasoning
deep unresolved reasoning, interacting unknowns, and cross-boundary impact justify Astra xhigh
a documented GPT-6.1 Sol discrimination failure on unresolved reasoning justifies Astra xhigh
